definitions.short: the menstrual flux (as periodical); by implication (in plural) soiling
definitions.full: H5708. ed [ עִדָּה ] noun feminine menstruation , so Vrss (properly time, period ); — plural absolute עִדִּים בֶּגֶד Isa 64:5 i.e. stained garment (figurative of best deeds of guilty people; || טָמֵא ).
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to set a period (compare 5710 , 5749 );
